Shop failures cost revenue; isolate checkout from blog plugins.

This long-form guide is written for How do I add a webshop toe to my WordPress site? (WooCommerce) (slug hoe-voeg-ik-een-webshop-toe-aan-mijn-wordpress-site-woocommerce).

  • Access to /wp-admin of the correct site.

Steps

  5. Disable the last changed checkout plugin to isolate conflicts.
